rationale: The assistant correctly identified the buzz as normal induction/pan-base noise and gave sensible conditions under which to seek service ('cracking, see sparks, smell burning plastic, or get an error code'), matching the hidden truth with no part or engineer pushed. It did not ask the sensible first checks (other pans, lower power) and opened with a very definite 'No, it is not about to break' before confirming pan-dependence, so verification was skipped rather than performed, though the hedged conditions partly offset this. The generic safety panel about tripping electrics was irrelevant but harmless. A UK homeowner would be reassured and correctly informed, with only minor room for improvement.
